page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core without hyperthreading, ensuring dedicated compute resources. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps. No graphics processing units are bundled with this hardware configuration, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the dedicated core allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.hfg6.16xlarge offers predictable compute performance for workloads sensitive to resource sharing. It is suitable for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, and moderate database workloads that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated CPU execution without hyperthreading overhead.
